Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter (payment integration)

Hi Dylan,

We're doing a vendor security intake for our Q3 payment integration and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the 2026 audit period (Jan 1 2026 - Dec 31 2026). If the attestation doesn't fully cover the dates we need, can you also provide a short bridge letter stating coverage dates and any gaps?

Our procurement team has asked for the following as part of the intake:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and accompanying auditor opinion
- Bridge letter if the report period doesn't include our contract window
- High-level list of controls tested and control owners (can be redacted)
- Incident log for 2026 (summary list)
- Encryption-at-rest configuration summary and KMS vendor

Please let us know secure transfer options (SFTP/S3/ShareFile) and the expected timeline to deliver these items. We also need a contact for evidence intake and any standard reply templates you use for procurement.

Thanks,
Karen Liu
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Novapay Risk & Compliance

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for calendar-year 2026 and a short bridge letter if you need coverage wording for any gap windows.

Quick answers up front:
- What we can share: SOC2_Redwood_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted where appropriate), bridge letter (if required), a one-page control map, and a 2026 incident summary.
- Typical redactions: customer-identifying data, internal usernames, and any third-party proprietary attachments. We won't redact control descriptions or auditor opinion text.
- Secure transfer options (pick one):
  1) Encrypted SFTP (preferred) — we can push to your incoming path or you can generate a temp account.
  2) S3 presigned URLs over TLS (expires after 72h).
  3) Secure Share (Box/ShareFile) with two-person approval.
- Timeline: assuming approval for transfer method, we can deliver the report + bridge letter and control map in 2–3 business days. Incident summary may take 3–5 business days depending on level of detail requested.

Can you confirm which transfer option you prefer and an intake contact for credentials (or a preferred directory)? Once you confirm I'll loop in our compliance lead to coordinate delivery.

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
